name: Mir Jafar
role: Commander and Later Nawab of Bengal
contribution: A senior commander in Siraj ud-Daulah's camp, he joined the anti-Siraj conspiracy and was installed as Nawab after Plassey.
context: Court and military politics of Bengal, 1757.
impact: His realignment was decisive in the outcome of Plassey and in the transfer of influence to the Company.
